# project conventions (CLAUDE.md):
# Santa's Secret Workshop (SSW) — Agent Guide

## Tech Stack
- **Runtime:** Expo 53 (React Native), React 19, Node 18+
- **Language:** TypeScript 5.8.3 (strict mode)
- **Styling:** NativeWind 4 (Tailwind CSS + React Native)
- **State:** Zustand 5
- **Backend:** Supabase (whhfugddqehxxbmwutsw)
- **Testing:** Node built-in `test` module
- **Web Platform:** Expo Web (react-native-web)

## Directory Map
- `app/` — Expo Router pages and root layout
- `components/` — React components (PascalCase, functional)
- `constants/theme.ts` — Design system: `T.*` namespace (colors, sizes, spacing)
- `hooks/` — Custom React hooks (`useXxx` pattern)
- `lib/` — Business logic (advent pass, commerce, economy, ai_safety, loot, etc.)
- `lib/__tests__/` — Unit tests (`*.test.ts`, Node test module)
- `types/index.ts` — TypeScript interfaces and types
- `utils/` — Utility functions (notifications, math, helpers)
- `store/` — Zustand stores (global state)
- `supabase/` — Edge functions and migrations
- `assets/` — Images, fonts, illustrations
- `scripts/` — Build/deploy helpers

## Git invariants (read before ANY commit or push)

These two invariants are why "improvements keep reverting" on this repo. Both
have bitten production. Check them, do not assume them.

**1. `master` must track `origin/master`.**
On 2026-07-27 the local checkout had `branch.master.merge` pointing at
`refs/heads/codex/unify-hisanta-brand` (a branch 126 commits stale). Effect:
`git pull` in the main checkout brought nothing, `git push` was refused for a
name mismatch, and the checkout silently fell 41 commits behind `origin/master`
while agents kept "improving" a stale tree. Verify with:

```bash
git rev-parse --abbrev-ref master@{upstream}   # must print origin/master
git config branch.master.merge                 # must print refs/heads/master
```

Fix: `git branch -u origin/master master`.

**2. Author AND committer must both be `kalepasch@gmail.com`.**
Vercel rejects any other identity as an unmapped author and the deploy never
ships. `.github/workflows/vercel-author-recovery.yml` papers over this with an
empty follow-up commit, which is why ~35% of history is
`chore: recover Vercel deploy after unmapped author`. Do not rely on it —
set the identity before committing:

```bash
git config user.name  "kalepasch1"
git config user.email "kalepasch@gmail.com"
```

**3. Never leave work uncommitted in the main checkout.**
The orchestrator sentinel stashes and resets the main checkout, and the quality
bot strip
